title: Delivery review is required before release

expectation.example: A local test can pass while a later scheduling stage or exported artifact still misses the user's goal.
expectation.expected: Every delivery record contains evidence for the original failure, later changes, final artifact, and a non-empty missed-scope/root-cause/early-detection review.
expectation.unchanged: No product behavior or scheduling rule is changed by this record.
expectation.fallback: If evidence is missing, keep the task unverified and block release instead of filling the record with a guess.

reproduction.reason: The prior 4/2 artifact is recorded as a reproducible failure and the current focused regression evidence is attached.

normalPath.reason: The current repository verification evidence covers the normal build and test path.

evidence.summary: Typecheck, tests, performance tests, and build passed.

alternatePath.reason: The flight-balance evidence covers large candidate sets, post-processing, and vacancy fallback branches.

evidence.summary: Focused branch and fallback tests passed.

postProcessing.reason: The current artifact was generated after scheduling finalization and independently counted from the exported personnel sheet.

finalGuard.reason: The acceptance records require all checks and review fields; the current record is complete and will be checked by the release script.

unchanged.reason: This record-only change leaves source, product behavior, and the scheduling contract unchanged.

evidence.summary: The preceding product change's owner page acceptance scope is recorded separately.

finalArtifact.reason: The related flight-balance task records the current generated export and its independent count; this review points to that artifact rather than claiming a test is a user artifact.

evidence.summary: Current generated export hash and independent count.

answers.originalFailure: The original failure was an exported 4/2 spread that local counting tests did not catch as a final artifact.
answers.laterChanges: The later work added full-path acceptance records, evidence hashes, post-processing checks, final guards, and release-time validation.
answers.finalArtifact: The current-code export evidence records the real configuration hash, generated workbook hash, assignment count, and independently deduplicated counts.

review.missedScope: The first implementation checked a local counter and did not check the finalized assignments or exported workbook.
review.rootCause: Knowledge was written in history but was not a mandatory, machine-checked delivery record tied to the current repository version.
review.earlyDetection: At task start initialize an acceptance record; before delivery fill every path, independently inspect the final artifact, answer the three delivery questions and three review questions, then run the full acceptance command.
